    def call(*args, **kwargs):

    transport.call = call

    def heartbeat():

        thread = threading.Thread(target=heartbeat, daemon=True)

                if runner.stopped(parent):
                    raise RuntimeError("Pilot stop marker exists")
                if runner.stopped(c):
